D23 Expo 2026 – Horizons: A Carousel of Progress Streaming Live on Disney+

Scott Sanders | August 10, 2026 | Leave a Comment
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:13
Instaread

Today, on the Disney Parks Blog, it has been announced that Saturday, August 15th, Horizons: A Carousel of Progress will stream live on Disney+ starting at 7:00 p.m. Pacific or 10:00 p.m. on the East Coast. This much-anticipated showcase will be hosted by Neil Patrick Harris, who will be joined by artists, storytellers, and creative leaders for a look at Disney’s projects in the works around the world.

Horizons will feature a series of conversations with Walt Disney Imagineering leaders and creative talent helping shape projects around the world – taking the audience on a journey through Disney’s unmatched storytelling legacy, the spirit of adventure at the heart of so many Disney stories, the remarkable creative process anchored by exploration and curiosity, and the bold promise of possibility that has guided Imagineers for more than seven decades.

And because this is still a Disney Experiences showcase, those conversations will be joined by high-energy performances, special moments, and a little Disney magic along the way.

Fans can expect project updates, first looks, new artwork and renderings, behind-the-scenes stories, creative insights, and a closer look at how some of Disney Experiences’ most ambitious projects are progressing. We’re pulling back the curtain on the work, collaboration, and imagination of many of the experiences in development that Disney fans are eagerly following.

While thousands of fans will fill the Honda Center in Anaheim, California, the showcase is designed to feel intimate rather than a big presentation hall.

Imagineers, in collaboration with Disney Experiences Chairman Thomas Mazloum, will engage in conversations that bridge the gap between creative minds and audiences. These conversations will transform concepts and artwork into immersive experiences that guests will eventually explore, ride, sail aboard, and enjoy.

Each Imagineer brings a unique perspective and passion to their work, whether leading large-scale portfolio planning, overseeing creative development, shaping immersive environments, or collaborating across global teams. Their collective efforts contribute to the creation of experiences that resonate with generations of Disney fans.

In the mean time, I would recommend watching the first two episodes of season 3 of Behind the Attraction on Disney plus for a look into the origin of Disney Cruise Line, and a look at the Disney Destiny.
